# kintone Provider

Manages kintone apps and their settings. Password authentication takes precedence when both authentication modes are configured.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "kintone" {
  # Set KINTONE_BASE_URL, KINTONE_USERNAME, and KINTONE_PASSWORD in the environment.
  # For token-only access to existing apps, use KINTONE_API_TOKENS instead.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_tokens` (List of String, Sensitive) Up to nine API tokens. Falls back to comma-separated KINTONE_API_TOKENS when omitted. Tokens cannot create or list apps.
- `base_url` (String) kintone HTTP(S) origin. Falls back to KINTONE_BASE_URL when omitted.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Service-account password. Falls back to KINTONE_PASSWORD when omitted.
- `username` (String) Service-account login name. Falls back to KINTONE_USERNAME when omitted.
